title: Irish Sausage Bake
description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring Irish sausage, potatoes, and cheese. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fix
ingredients.notes: herbs and spices, e.g. thyme, rosemary

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the Irish sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the sliced onion, diced potatoes, and sliced carrots to the skillet. Cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the frozen peas and baked beans. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
